data.transcript: Gusto ko pong bumili ng chest freezer para sa ice candy at frozen goods, mga 18,000 pesos, tapos dagdag stock para sa Pasko. Siguro mga 2,500 pesos po ang dagdag kita ko kada buwan.
data.english: I want to buy a chest freezer for ice candy and frozen goods, around 18,000 pesos, then additional stock for Christmas. Maybe my additional monthly income will be around 2,500 pesos.

facts.purpose: Buy a chest freezer and additional stock
